verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs and support articles, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists; Terminal sits on that same Stripe API platform. The evidence is platform-level rather than Terminal-specific. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Terminal-specific tools (readers, locations, in-person payments), setup and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
